summary.text: Julie Coulombe, a Republican, has represented District 11 in the Alaska House of Representatives since 2023.

paragraphs.text: The legislative biography says Coulombe and husband Marc arrived in Alaska in 1986 and were stationed at Fort Richardson, and that they have lived in South Anchorage for the past twenty years.

The biography lists a B.A. in journalism and public communications from the University of Alaska Anchorage, 15 years in retail and sales management, and service as vice president of the Huffman/O'Malley Community Council.
